description: Defines data structures, enums, and types related to positioning measurement information in a 3GPP-like system, including AoA, RSRP, timing, and measurement request/response structures.

classes.name: search_win_info_t
classes.description: Contains expected propagation delay and delay uncertainty for search window.

classes.name: expected_azimuth_aoa_t
classes.description: Contains expected azimuth angle of arrival and its uncertainty.

classes.name: expected_zenith_aoa_t
classes.description: Contains expected zenith angle of arrival and its uncertainty.

classes.name: expected_ul_aoa_t
classes.description: Contains expected UL AoA with azimuth and optional zenith components.

classes.name: expected_zoa_only_t
classes.description: Contains expected zenith angle of arrival only.

classes.name: aoa_assist_info_t
classes.description: Contains angle measurement type and optional translation info.

classes.name: trp_meas_request_item_t
classes.description: Represents a measurement request item with optional search window, CGI, AoA search window, and TRP rx/tx tags.

classes.name: trp_meas_quantities_item_t
classes.description: Enumeration of measurement quantities like time difference, RSRP, AoA, RTOA.

classes.name: trp_meas_quantities_list_item_t
classes.description: List item specifying measurement quantity and optional granularity.

classes.name: response_time_t
classes.description: Represents a response time with value and time unit.

classes.name: ul_angle_of_arrival_t
classes.description: Contains azimuth, optional zenith AoA, and optional translation.

classes.name: ul_rtoa_meas_t
classes.description: Contains RTOA measurement type and value.

classes.name: relative_path_delay_t
classes.description: Contains delay type and value.

classes.name: trp_meas_timing_quality_t
classes.description: Represents timing quality with resolution and measurement quality.

classes.name: trp_meas_angle_quality_t
classes.description: Represents angle quality with azimuth, optional zenith, and resolution.

classes.name: trp_meas_quality_t
classes.description: Variant of timing or angle quality.

classes.name: zoa_t
classes.description: Contains zenith AoA and optional translation.

classes.name: multiple_ul_aoa_item_t
classes.description: Variant of UL AoA or ZOA.

classes.name: ul_srs_rsrp_pwr_t
classes.description: Contains first path RSRP power.

classes.name: add_path_list_item_t
classes.description: Represents a path with delay, optional quality, multiple AoA, and power.

classes.name: trp_rx_teg_info_t
classes.description: Contains TRP RX TEG ID and timing error margin.

classes.name: ul_rtoa_t
classes.description: Contains RTOA measurement, add path list, extended list, and optional TRP RX TEG info.

classes.name: gnb_rx_tx_time_diff_meas_t
classes.description: Contains RX/TX time difference measurement type and value.

classes.name: rx_tx_timing_error_margin_t
classes.description: Contains timing error margin type and provides conversion to float.

classes.name: trp_rx_tx_teg_info_t
classes.description: Contains TRP RX/TX TEG ID and timing error margin.

classes.name: rx_tx_teg_t
classes.description: Contains RX and TX TEG info, optional TX TEG.

classes.name: rx_teg_t
classes.description: Contains RX and TX TEG info.

classes.name: trp_teg_info_t
classes.description: Variant of RX/TX TEG or RX/TX TEG.

classes.name: gnb_rx_tx_time_diff_t
classes.description: Contains RX/TX time difference measurement and add path lists.

classes.name: trp_measured_results_value_t
classes.description: Variant of UL AoA, uint8, RTOA, or GNB RX/TX time difference.

classes.name: meas_beam_info_t
classes.description: Contains optional beam resource IDs and SSB index.

classes.name: trp_meas_result_item_t
classes.description: Measurement result with value, timestamp, optional quality and beam info.

classes.name: trp_measurement_response_item_t
classes.description: Response item with TRP ID, measurement results, and optional CGI.

methods.name: static float to_float(const resolution_t::value_t& enum_val)
methods.description: Converts resolution enum to float value.

methods.name: static float to_float()
methods.description: Returns fixed float value 0.1 for angle resolution.
